newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP Q4 to be below some forecasts-Prescott.
newsitem.headline: BHP Q4 to be below some forecasts-Prescott.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) managing director said on Monday that the fourth quarter results due next month would be flat and below some forecasts currently in the market.
"The fourth quarter is likely to have an outcome that seems to be below what some people assume it will be," Prescott told a meeting.
Earlier on Monday, BHP announced that trading conditions had been difficult in the fourth quarter ending May 31 and that it saw a flat performance.
Announcing it had completed a review of its future strategies, BHP said it expected a flat performance until it restructured and new projects were commissioned.
BHP said there would be a number of abnormal adjustments to the full year to May 31 results, due on June 27, and that some of them would have an adverse impact.
BHP shares were 40 cents lower at A$18.92 at 3.30 p.m. (0530 GMT).
